s0001.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on gengzi day the Emperor said to those beside him: "The central secretariat has lately reported that the common people lack food; relief should be increased.
s0001.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, on gengzi day the Emperor said to those beside him, "The central secretariat has lately reported that the common people lack food; relief should be increased.

s0002.literal: We have pondered this in silence: the people hunger so — could there be errors in government that have brought this about?
s0002.idiomatic: We have pondered this in silence: the people hunger so — could there be errors in government that have brought this about?

s0003.literal: We earlier decreed that all offices should earnestly follow Shizu's established institutions; they should strive to carry them out and assist Us where We fall short. Yet We have often reflected that only by reducing punishments and lightening taxes can the common people each pursue their livelihood.
s0003.idiomatic: We earlier decreed that all offices should earnestly follow Shizu's established institutions; they should strive to carry them out and assist Us where We fall short. Yet We have often reflected that only by reducing punishments and lightening taxes can the common people each pursue their livelihood.

s0004.literal: " On yimao day Prince Toghto was stationed in Yunnan, harassing troops and commoners; Anhui was appointed to replace him.
s0004.idiomatic: " On yimao day Prince Toghto was stationed in Yunnan, harassing troops and commoners; Anhui was appointed to replace him.

s0005.literal: On bingchen day Vanchu, privy council administrator, was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor.
s0005.idiomatic: On bingchen day Vanchu, privy council administrator, was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0006.literal: On jiwei day ten thousand ingots of notes were issued as grain stipends for the Imperial Preceptor's temple.
s0006.idiomatic: On jiwei day 10,000 ingots of notes were issued as grain stipends for the Imperial Preceptor's temple.

s0007.literal: On renxu day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.
s0007.idiomatic: On renxu day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.

s0008.literal: On wuchen day three months' grain was granted to the followings of Princes Yisubughan and Mingandaa.
s0008.idiomatic: On wuchen day 3 months' grain was granted to the followings of Princes Yisubughan and Mingandaa.

s0009.literal: Intercalary month, on gengchen day Prince Boluo was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji.
s0009.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on gengchen day Prince Boluo was enfeoffed as Prince of Ji.

s0010.literal: On bingxu day, because the crown prince was established, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; notes were granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; land tax and levies on the various routes were remitted in varying degrees.
s0010.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because the crown prince was established, an edict was proclaimed to the realm; notes were granted to widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; land tax and levies on the various routes were remitted in varying degrees.

s0011.literal: Princes, imperial kin, and those who attended court were granted three hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and forty-three thousand nine hundred ingots of notes.
s0011.idiomatic: Princes, imperial kin, and those who attended court were granted 300 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 43,900 ingots of notes.

s0012.literal: On xinmao day Betemür was enfeoffed as Prince of Fenyang.
s0012.idiomatic: On xinmao day Betemür was enfeoffed as Prince of Fenyang.

s0013.literal: On renchen day Prince Bin Nanhuli's following was granted one hundred twenty thousand ingots of notes to buy horses.
s0013.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince Bin Nanhuli's following was granted 120,000 ingots of notes to buy horses.

s0014.literal: The people of Bianliang, Yangzhou, Henan, Huai'an, Chongqing, Shunqing, and Xiangyang all suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain issued for relief.
s0014.idiomatic: The people of Bianliang, Yangzhou, Henan, Huai'an, Chongqing, Shunqing, and Xiangyang all suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain issued for relief.

s0015.literal: Second month, on gengzi day Prince Mailu's following was granted thirty thousand ingots of notes.
s0015.idiomatic: Second month, on gengzi day Prince Mailu's following was granted 30,000 ingots of notes.

s0016.literal: On jiachen day an edict directed every community in each commandery and county to re-establish charity granaries.
s0016.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict directed every community in each commandery and county to re-establish charity granaries.

s0017.literal: On wushen day attendant Wanbu Hua was specially appointed Hanlin Academician Reader, drafter of edicts, and associate compiler of the national history.
s0017.idiomatic: On wushen day attendant Wanbu Hua was specially appointed Hanlin Academician Reader, drafter of edicts, and associate compiler of the national history.

s0018.literal: On guihai day Taining Prefecture was raised to Taining Route, and Taining County was still established.
s0018.idiomatic: On guihai day Taining Prefecture was raised to Taining Route, and Taining County was still established.

s0019.literal: On yichou day the rank of the Mongol Directorate of Education was raised to primary third grade, and a silver seal was granted.
s0019.idiomatic: On yichou day the rank of the Mongol Directorate of Education was raised to primary third grade, and a silver seal was granted.

s0020.literal: On bingyin day, because princes' followings had suffered the turmoil of the rebel Tuhochi and the common people were impoverished, one hundred sixty-six thousand ingots of notes and ten thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0020.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because princes' followings had suffered the turmoil of the rebel Tuhochi and the common people were impoverished, 166,000 ingots of notes and 10,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0021.literal: Caozhou suffered flooding; this year's land tax was remitted.
s0021.idiomatic: Caozhou suffered flooding; this year's land tax was remitted.

s0022.literal: Third month, on dingmao new moon, Jing Prefecture was raised to Jing Route.
s0022.idiomatic: Third month, on dingmao new moon, Jing Prefecture was raised to Jing Route.

s0023.literal: On gengwu day four thousand shi of grain were granted to Prince of Zhao Arghun's following.
s0023.idiomatic: On gengwu day 4,000 shi of grain were granted to Prince of Zhao Arghun's following.

s0024.literal: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Winnowing Basket.
s0024.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Winnowing Basket.

s0025.literal: On xinmao day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0025.idiomatic: On xinmao day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

s0026.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu day three months' military grain was granted to Prince of An Udsibuyah's following.
s0026.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on wuxu day 3 months' military grain was granted to Prince of An Udsibuyah's following.

s0027.literal: On jihai day Dean Prefecture suffered drought; garrison-farm land tax was remitted.
s0027.idiomatic: On jihai day Dean Prefecture suffered drought; garrison-farm land tax was remitted.

s0028.literal: On renyin day Commissioner of the Grand Ceremonies Bureau Xiao Baizhu was additionally appointed Grand Tutor; Prince of Zhao Arghun was granted fifty taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and one thousand ingots of notes; Huailai County was detached and placed under Longqing Prefecture.
s0028.idiomatic: On renyin day commissioner of the Grand Ceremonies Bureau Xiao Baizhu was additionally appointed grand tutor; Prince of Zhao Arghun was granted 50 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 1,000 ingots of notes; Huailai County was detached and placed under Longqing Prefecture.

s0029.literal: On jiachen day Taining Route was placed under Liaoyang Province.
s0029.idiomatic: On jiachen day Taining Route was placed under Liaoyang Province.

s0030.literal: On wushen day Dengzhong raided the frontier; Prince Wu Duoliena and others defeated him at Hehuai; gold and jade belts, gold, and silks and cloths were granted in varying amounts.
s0030.idiomatic: On wushen day Dengzhong raided the frontier; Prince Wu Duoliena and others defeated him at Hehuai; gold and jade belts, gold, and silks and cloths were granted in varying amounts.

s0031.literal: On jiwei day Prince Niulian died.
s0031.idiomatic: On jiwei day Prince Niulian died.

s0032.literal: On yichou day wine was forbidden in Lingbei.
s0032.idiomatic: On yichou day wine was forbidden in Lingbei.

s0033.literal: Once when the Emperor was sitting at night, he said to attending ministers: "Rain and drought are untimely — what is to be done?
s0033.idiomatic: Once when the Emperor was sitting at night, he said to attending ministers, "Rain and drought are untimely — what is to be done?

s0034.literal: " Xiao Baizhu replied: "This is the fault of the chancellor.
s0034.idiomatic: " Xiao Baizhu replied, "This is the fault of the chancellor.

s0035.literal: " The Emperor said: "Are you not in the central secretariat?
s0035.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Are you not in the central secretariat?

s0036.literal: " Xiao Baizhu was ashamed and remorseful.
s0036.idiomatic: " Xiao Baizhu was ashamed and remorseful.

s0037.literal: Shortly afterward, the Emperor exposed incense and prayed in silence.
s0037.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the Emperor exposed incense and prayed in silence.

s0038.literal: Soon heavy rain fell; attendants brought rain garments forward; the Emperor said: "We pray for rain for the people — why avoid it!
s0038.idiomatic: Soon heavy rain fell; attendants brought rain garments forward; the Emperor said, "We pray for rain for the people — why avoid it!

s0039.literal: " Hanlin Academician Exemplar Qutlughdushmish and Liu Geng and others translated the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 and presented it; the Emperor read it and said to the assembled ministers: "The discussions in the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 are very fine; order Hanlin Academician Alintemür to translate it into the national language.
s0039.idiomatic: " Hanlin Academician Exemplar Qutlughdushmish and Liu Geng and others translated the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 and presented it; the Emperor read it and said to the assembled ministers, "The discussions in the 《Great Learning Extended Meaning》 are very fine; order Hanlin Academician Alintemür to translate it into the national language.

s0040.literal: " Fifth month, on xinwei day Shangdu resident commissioner Kuokuo was granted Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies and Grand Tutor.
s0040.idiomatic: " Fifth month, on xinwei day Shangdu resident commissioner Kuokuo was granted commissioner with the ceremonial standing equal to the Three Excellencies and grand tutor.

s0041.literal: On renshen day princes on campaign including Chouhan were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, and notes.
s0041.idiomatic: On renshen day princes on campaign including Chouhan were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, and notes.

s0042.literal: On yihai day Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was further enfeoffed as Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess, and a gold seal was granted.
s0042.idiomatic: On yihai day Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was further enfeoffed as Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess, and a gold seal was granted.

s0043.literal: On wuyin day the Guard Rate Office was changed to the Zhongyi Office.
s0043.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Guard Rate Office was changed to the Zhongyi Office.

s0044.literal: On renwu day at Huangzhou, Gaoyou, Zhenzhou, Jianning, and other places, refugees gathered in groups, bearing arms and plundering; an edict directed the local offices that those who injured people and thieves should be punished, while the remainder should all be given grain and sent home.
s0044.idiomatic: On renwu day at Huangzhou, Gaoyou, Zhenzhou, Jianning, and other places, refugees gathered in groups, bearing arms and plundering; an edict directed the local offices that those who injured people and thieves should be punished, while the remainder should all be given grain and sent home.

s0045.literal: Hanlin Academician Exemplar Chigin Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor; central secretariat grand councillor Wuberdula was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.
s0045.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Exemplar Chigin Temür was made central secretariat grand councillor; central secretariat grand councillor Wuberdula was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.

s0046.literal: On jichou day central secretariat left vice chancellor Abuhaiya was promoted to grand councillor; associate administrator Qita was made right vice chancellor, Gao Fang left vice chancellor; deliberators on central secretariat affairs Huanzhu and Zhang Siming were both made associate administrators.
s0046.idiomatic: On jichou day central secretariat left vice chancellor Abuhaiya was promoted to grand councillor; associate administrator Qita was made right vice chancellor, Gao Fang left vice chancellor; deliberators on central secretariat affairs Huanzhu and Zhang Siming were both made associate administrators.

s0047.literal: Sixth month, on yisi day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0047.idiomatic: Sixth month, on yisi day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0048.literal: More than forty surveillance censors inside and outside the court impeached Temüder for wickedness, corruption, and unlawful conduct.
s0048.idiomatic: More than 40 surveillance censors inside and outside the court impeached Temüder for wickedness, corruption, and unlawful conduct.

s0049.literal: On wushen day Temüder was dismissed; left chancellor Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0049.idiomatic: On wushen day Temüder was dismissed; left chancellor Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0050.literal: On jiyou day Wuberdula was again made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0050.idiomatic: On jiyou day Wuberdula was again made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0051.literal: On renzi day Minister of Works Wang Gui was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0051.idiomatic: On renzi day minister of works Wang Gui was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0052.literal: Princes of Anyuan Chouhan and Zhao Arghun had been plundered by the rebel Tuhochi; each was granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths.
s0052.idiomatic: Princes of Anyuan Chouhan and Zhao Arghun had been plundered by the rebel Tuhochi; each was granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths.

s0053.literal: On bingchen day an edict directed: "For apportioned fiefs of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious subjects, the former system of appointing darughachi at their own discretion still applies.
s0053.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict directed, "For apportioned fiefs of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious subjects, the former system of appointing darughachi at their own discretion still applies.

s0054.literal: " On disi day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched envoys to enter tribute.
s0054.idiomatic: " On disi day the Kingdom of Annam dispatched envoys to enter tribute.

s0055.literal: On wuwu day two princely tutors were established for Prince of Ji Boluo; one each of commander-in-chief and marshal; the Overall Directorate rank primary third grade.
s0055.idiomatic: On wuwu day 2 princely tutors were established for Prince of Ji Boluo; 1 each of commander-in-chief and marshal; the Overall Directorate rank primary third grade.

s0056.literal: On jiwei day nine hundred thousand ingots of notes and fifty thousand bolts of miscellaneous silks were granted for the Lingbei branch secretariat operating expenses.
s0056.idiomatic: On jiwei day 900,000 ingots of notes and 50,000 bolts of miscellaneous silks were granted for the Lingbei branch secretariat operating expenses.

s0057.literal: On guihai day it was forbidden for the White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren, wearing the Grand Guardian seal, to issue documents to government offices.
s0057.idiomatic: On guihai day it was forbidden for the White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren, wearing the Grand Guardian seal, to issue documents to government offices.

s0058.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yihai day Li Meng was dismissed; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left vice chancellor Wang Yi was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0058.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on yihai day Li Meng was dismissed; Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left vice chancellor Wang Yi was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0059.literal: On gengchen day Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was granted one hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloths.
s0059.idiomatic: On gengchen day Imperial Aunt Grand Eldest Princess Manggotai was granted 100 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 100 bolts each of silks and cloths.

s0060.literal: Jurong Commandery Prince Chuangwu'er and others who had merit in suppressing the rebel prince were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks and cloths, and notes.
s0060.idiomatic: Jurong Commandery Prince Chuangwu'er and others who had merit in suppressing the rebel prince were granted graded amounts of gold, silver, silks and cloths, and notes.

s0061.literal: On renwu day an edict directed Chigin Temür to distribute rewards to princes and imperial sons-in-law, and to relieve impoverishment in their followings.
s0061.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict directed Chigin Temür to distribute rewards to princes and imperial sons-in-law, and to relieve impoverishment in their followings.

s0062.literal: Central Guard personal army commander Bolanxi was specially appointed Grand Marshal.
s0062.idiomatic: Central Guard personal army commander Bolanxi was specially appointed grand marshal.

s0063.literal: On jichou day Chenji County suffered a mountain collapse; earth and stones slid away, destroying fields and dwellings, crushing residents to death.
s0063.idiomatic: On jichou day Chenji County suffered a mountain collapse; earth and stones slid away, destroying fields and dwellings, crushing residents to death.

s0064.literal: On xinmao day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.
s0064.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.

s0065.literal: The Emperor instructed secretariat officials: "We have lately heard that Mongol followings are distressed and often sell sons and daughters to commoner households as slaves and servants; order the offices to redeem them and return them to their respective followings.
s0065.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed secretariat officials, "We have lately heard that Mongol followings are distressed and often sell sons and daughters to commoner households as slaves and servants; order the offices to redeem them and return them to their respective followings.

s0066.literal: " When the Emperor went out, he saw a guard in worn clothing; he reined in his horse and asked him; the man replied: "I have garrisoned a frontier fortress for more than fifteen years — that is why I am poor.
s0066.idiomatic: " When the Emperor went out, he saw a guard in worn clothing; he reined in his horse and asked him; the man replied, "I have garrisoned a frontier fortress for more than 15 years — that is why I am poor.

s0067.literal: " The Emperor said: "These men have long labored afar; the officials left behind have never reported it to Us — had We not seen it in person, how could We have known!
s0067.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "These men have long labored afar; the officials left behind have never reported it to Us — had We not seen it in person, how could We have known!

s0068.literal: From now on, whenever there are cases like this, you must report them to Us.
s0068.idiomatic: From now on, whenever there are cases like this, you must report them to Us.

s0069.literal: " Thereupon he ordered them granted money and silks.
s0069.idiomatic: " Thereupon he ordered them granted money and silks.

s0070.literal: Eighth month, on bingshen day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.
s0070.idiomatic: Eighth month, on bingshen day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.

s0072.literal: On renzi day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0072.idiomatic: On renzi day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0073.literal: On gengshen day after Hesan had finished presenting affairs, the Emperor asked: "What affairs do you daily carry out?
s0073.idiomatic: On gengshen day after Hesan had finished presenting affairs, the Emperor asked, "What affairs do you daily carry out?

s0074.literal: " Hesan replied: "We your ministers simply carry out edicts — nothing more.
s0074.idiomatic: " Hesan replied, "We your ministers simply carry out edicts — nothing more.

s0075.literal: " The Emperor said: "Have you ever carried out Our instructions? Even the ancestral teachings and court laws and regulations — none are observed.
s0075.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Have you ever carried out Our instructions? Even the ancestral teachings and court laws and regulations — none are observed.

s0076.literal: Laws are what distinguish high from low and settle the people's minds; from antiquity to the present, there has never been a time when the realm was well governed without laws established.
s0076.idiomatic: Laws are what distinguish high from low and settle the people's minds; from antiquity to the present, there has never been a time when the realm was well governed without laws established.

s0077.literal: If the ruler makes laws and the chancellor can preserve them without loss, then the people below will know what to fear and avoid, the bonds of discipline can be set right, and customs can be enriched.
s0077.idiomatic: If the ruler makes laws and the chancellor can preserve them without loss, then the people below will know what to fear and avoid, the bonds of discipline can be set right, and customs can be enriched.

s0078.literal: If laws slacken and the people grow insolent, complaints arise together — to seek peace and order, would it not be difficult?
s0078.idiomatic: If laws slacken and the people grow insolent, complaints arise together — to seek peace and order, would it not be difficult?

s0079.literal: " Ninth month, on bingyin day Hesan said: "By precedent, a chancellor must be a meritorious Mongol minister;
s0079.idiomatic: " Ninth month, on bingyin day Hesan said, "By precedent, a chancellor must be a meritorious Mongol minister;

s0080.literal: Hesan is a Muslim and does not satisfy public expectation.
s0080.idiomatic: Hesan is a Muslim and does not satisfy public expectation.

s0081.literal: " He then earnestly declined; by imperial rescript Communications Court commissioner Baidashah was made right chancellor of the central secretariat, and Hesan was made left chancellor.
s0081.idiomatic: " He then earnestly declined; by imperial rescript Communications Court commissioner Baidashah was made right chancellor of the central secretariat, and Hesan was made left chancellor.

s0082.literal: On jisi day in the southern city of Dadu auspicious grain appeared, one stalk with eleven ears.
s0082.idiomatic: On jisi day in the southern city of Dadu auspicious grain appeared, 1 stalk with 11 ears.

s0083.literal: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Dipper.
s0083.idiomatic: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Dipper.

s0084.literal: On renchen day an edict admonished and regulated sea transport grain, instructing the various offices not to obstruct it.
s0084.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict admonished and regulated sea transport grain, instructing the various offices not to obstruct it.

s0085.literal: Lingbei suffered earthquakes for three days.

s0086.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu new moon, sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0086.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu new moon, sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0087.literal: On wuxu day five thousand shi of grain were granted to the followings of Prince Huanghuo Temür and others.
s0087.idiomatic: On wuxu day 5,000 shi of grain were granted to the followings of Prince Huanghuo Temür and others.

s0088.literal: On renyin day an edict directed the Minister of Punishments to nominate Lin Bai to oversee the Dadu Metropolitan Horse Command in suppressing bandits, and to strictly regulate military officers and control their entry and exit.
s0088.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict directed the minister of punishments to nominate Lin Bai to oversee the Dadu Metropolitan Horse Command in suppressing bandits, and to strictly regulate military officers and control their entry and exit.

s0089.literal: Censor-in-chief Boghu and associate administrator Wang Gui were dispatched to sacrifice at Shaanxi's famous mountains and river shrines, and to relieve the people of Qin Prefecture who had suffered disaster.
s0089.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Boghu and associate administrator Wang Gui were dispatched to sacrifice at Shaanxi's famous mountains and river shrines, and to relieve the people of Qin Prefecture who had suffered disaster.

s0090.literal: On jiyou day surveillance censor officials said: "When officials leave mourning and resume office, public sentiment is alarmed and unsettled; We request that this be forbidden to cut off opportunism.
s0090.idiomatic: On jiyou day surveillance censor officials said, "When officials leave mourning and resume office, public sentiment is alarmed and unsettled; We request that this be forbidden to cut off opportunism.

s0091.literal: Only when the court's elder veterans are specially ordered by edict to resume office should this be outside the prohibition.
s0091.idiomatic: Only when the court's elder veterans are specially ordered by edict to resume office should this be outside the prohibition.

s0093.literal: " Salary fields were granted to the Liang-Huai Garrison-Farm Overall Directorate.
s0093.idiomatic: " Salary fields were granted to the Liang-Huai Garrison-Farm Overall Directorate.

s0094.literal: On renzi day fifty thousand ingots of notes and fifty thousand shi of grain were granted to relieve Chaghan Na'ur.
s0094.idiomatic: On renzi day 50,000 ingots of notes and 50,000 shi of grain were granted to relieve Chaghan Na'ur.

s0095.literal: On wuwu day the people of Boluo Gong in the overseas lands went to trade among the maritime barbarians; encountering wind and waves, the fourteen survivors drifted to Wenzhou's Yongjia County; an edict directed the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to supply funds and send them home.
s0095.idiomatic: On wuwu day the people of Boluo Gong in the overseas lands went to trade among the maritime barbarians; encountering wind and waves, the 14 survivors drifted to Wenzhou's Yongjia County; an edict directed the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to supply funds and send them home.

s0096.literal: Meizhou under Chaozhou Route was changed to be subordinate to the Guangdong Circuit Pacification Commission.
s0096.idiomatic: Meizhou under Chaozhou Route was changed to be subordinate to the Guangdong Circuit Pacification Commission.

s0097.literal: Eleventh month, on jimao day the Yangzhou Grand Canal was dredged anew.
s0097.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jimao day the Yangzhou Grand Canal was dredged anew.

s0098.literal: On jichou day Qianyuan County was merged into Long Prefecture.
s0098.idiomatic: On jichou day Qianyuan County was merged into Long Prefecture.

s0099.literal: On renchen day an edict directed: "Palace guards entering duty should each remain at their post; without an edict they may not ascend the hall; those who force entry into the forbidden inner palace shall be punished.
s0099.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict directed, "Palace guards entering duty should each remain at their post; without an edict they may not ascend the hall; those who force entry into the forbidden inner palace shall be punished.

s0100.literal: Ministers may be accompanied by two persons, other officials by one; gatekeepers shall inspect their coming and going.
s0100.idiomatic: Ministers may be accompanied by 2 persons, other officials by 1; gatekeepers shall inspect their coming and going.
